followup_explanation:
I routed to Petrel-235B because the task is a routine, non-sensitive one (drafting a formal business letter), so the only meaningful differentiator was raw capability.

On the relevant metrics, Petrel scores higher than Avocet across every dimension that matters here:

- **IFEval 89.8 vs 85.6** — relevant because the user gave explicit instructions ("formal letter," "Don't mess it up").
- **Creative/composition & Support Dialogue** — Petrel leads on Creative Generation (84.7 vs 78.8) and Support Dialogue (83.9 vs 79.4), both of which bear directly on writing a customer-service response.
- **Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4** — a general quality signal favoring Petrel.

The task-preference sections were not a factor: those only differentiate the models on harm-adjacent or distasteful content, and this letter is benign. So I defaulted to the higher-capability model.
